description: This file contains functions for configuring and retrieving settings related to the shared meter feature on a Realtek RTL8367C switch. It includes APIs to set/get meter rates, thresholds, types, and statuses, primarily for managing bandwidth or packet rate measurements on network ports.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicShareMeter(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 rate,rtk_uint32 ifg)
methods.description: Configures the rate and IFG setting for a shared meter specified by its index. Handles different register offsets depending on whether the index is below 32 or higher.
parameters: ifg - include or exclude Inter-Frame Gap in rate calculation (1:include, 0:exclude)

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicShareMeter(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pRate,rtk_uint32 * pIfg)
methods.description: Retrieves the current rate and IFG setting for a shared meter by its index.
parameters: pRate - pointer to store the 17-bit rate
pIfg - pointer to store IFG inclusion flag

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicShareMeterBucketSize(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 lbthreshold)
methods.description: Sets the leaky bucket threshold for the specified shared meter.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicShareMeterBucketSize(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pLbthreshold)
methods.description: Gets the leaky bucket threshold for the specified shared meter.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicShareMeterType(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 type)
methods.description: Sets the measurement type of the shared meter (kbps or pps).

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicShareMeterType(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pType)
methods.description: Retrieves the measurement type of the shared meter.
parameters: pType - pointer to store the type (0 or 1)

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicMeterExceedStatus(rtk_uint32 index)
methods.description: Clears the exceed (over rate) status indicator for a shared meter.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicMeterExceedStatus(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pStatus)
methods.description: Checks if the shared meter's rate exceeds its configured threshold, returning the status.
parameters: pStatus - pointer to store status (0: not exceeded, 1: exceeded)

ctags.name: rtl8367c_setAsicShareMeter
ctags.pattern: /^ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicShareMeter(rtk_uint32 index, rtk_uint32 rate, rtk_uint32 ifg)$/
